pages.title: World Wyrms
pages.text: $(item)World Wyrms$() are majestic beings that, when trained properly, tunnel deep into the ground to retrieve ores.$(br2)In the past we have just let them access the deep depths of our own planet to find ores we normally don't get to. But since we found $(item)Pocket Dimensions$(), we can train them to go there instead.

pages.title: Wyrm Burrow
pages.notes: The $(item)Transdimensional Wyrm Burrow$() is a safe base of operations for a $(item)World Wyrm$().$(br)It is where it will deposit all ores it finds.$(br2)It's also a place of rest and where the $(item)Wyrm$() comes to drink the $(item)Wyrm Milk$().

pages.text: Pull up $(l:portal_hub/4_schematica)Schematica$() to see the bill of materials for this multiblock structure.$(br2)You should build 2 burrows at once if possible.$(br2)Once the $(item)Transdimensional Wyrm Burrow$() is complete, you can start the rigourous process of training larvae for ascension.$(br2)Making a larvae ready for ascension takes a lot of $(item)Wyrm Milk$(), you will probably need 20-30 buckets worth for your first wyrm.

The larvae that could even remotely be worthy of being ascended into a $(item)World Wyrm$() is found in the $(item)Midnight Pocket Dimension$().$(br2)They can be obtained by slaying $(l:sim_4/resources/1_inhabitants#crystalbug)crystal bugs$().

Before we can bring a $(item)World Wyrm$() into this world we will need some help from our friends the Elves.$(br2)Binding a $(item)Nightstag$() soul with a $(item)Gold Horse Armor$() will make it ready for sacrifice.$(br2)Collecting the $(item)Nighstag Souls$() can be automated with a $(item)Mob Imprisonment Tool$().

After the $(item)Sacrificial Nightstag$() has been sacrificed by the Elves you will have to anoint it with a $(item)Starlight Infuser$().$(br2)Once you have the anointed remains you can birth your first $(item)World Wyrm$() in the $(item)Slate Ossuary$().
